response.sql:
WITH units AS (
  SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS own
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
base AS (
  SELECT u.*, AVG(own) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_base,
         AVG(own) OVER () AS overall
  FROM units u
)
SELECT AVG(own) AS avg_ownership,
       AVG(own / NULLIF(mix_base, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_mix_baseline,
       AVG(own - overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall
FROM base
WHERE own > overall

assumptions.assumption: Units whose ownership is NULL (all snapshots missing instownpct) are kept as units in the baseline calculations only in the sense that AVG ignores their NULL ownership; they cannot pass the strictly-above filter.
The overall average is the unweighted average of unit ownerships (one value per unit), not of individual snapshots.
A mix baseline of zero yields a NULL ratio, which AVG ignores.
